evidence.ACL: chronic complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance.
evidence.MCL: The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: complex tear (main radial component) at the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: complex tear with buckethandle tear at the anterior horn, body and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus.
evidence.Medial OA: Mild medial tibiofemoral compartmental osteoarthritis of the right knee by evidence of chondrosis, subchondral edema and osteophytes.
evidence.Lateral OA: There is focal high grade chondrosis at the the posterolateral tibial plateau (about 1.5* 1.9 cm). There is subchondral edema. Osteophytes are present.
evidence.PF OA: focal grade  chondrosis (less than 50% thickness cartilage loss) at the medial patellar facet
evidence.Effusion: Minimal amount of right knee effusion is present.
evidence.Fracture: There is no subchondral edema. Osteophytes are present.
